verdict.rationale: PostHog's own data pipeline sends event data in real time to 25+ tools or any webhook. It also turns product signals such as errors and rage clicks into reports and pull requests automatically. Together these show event-driven automated actions, but the evidence never describes a user-defined rule or condition builder. Missing for 10: documented user-defined trigger rules and filters, the range of actions beyond forwarding and reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Send it to 25+ tools or any webhook in real time, or batch export large amounts to your warehouse.
Turn signals in your product data (errors, rage clicks, failed queries, and more) into researched reports and pull requests, delivered to your Inbox for you to review and merge.
